profile.headline: Software Engineer @ OroSolutions | B.S. Computer Science | Google Tech Exchange ‘23 | ColorStack
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer with a foundation in financial technology, where I develop automated reporting systems that help clients and staff make smarter decisions with their data. Working in FinTech has sharpened my appreciation for what’s at stake when software handles sensitive financial information — and it’s pushed me to go deeper into the security side of things. I’m actively working toward a career in application security, combining my engineering background with a growing toolkit in offensive and defensive security practices.
